issues.title: Generate mock "activities" dataset
issues.body:
Generate a body of fake "activities" objects, with these requirements:
* [ ] top-level grouping of "Maritime", "Land", "Air", "Other"
* [ ] Each activity will include:
   * [ ] name of activity
   * [ ] list of geometries (geometry-name, domain-name)
   * [ ] template to open on completion
   * [ ] color for activity [**icon?**]

Suspect we can have these sample permutations:
1. [polyline, polygon, polyline] (route-in, target area, route-out)
2. [polygon] (target area)
3. [polyline, point, polyline] (route-in, target, route-out)
4. [point] (target location)

Introduce nomenclature to indicate geometry is optional. So, if geometry-name is "polygon?" - then player can skip providing polygon. This is the case if OpFor targets have already been specified.
